text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The joint reports and the responses to them are collected by the Federal Council Affairs Section and noted on a list of differences, which the Federal Council refers to on the day of its meeting when debating and making its decisions.", "gist": "Joint reports and responses are collected by the Federal Council Affairs Section and listed for Council reference during meetings."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council Affairs Section", "gist": "Section responsible for collecting joint reports and responses"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council", "gist": "Body that refers to the list of differences during meetings"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Government and Administration Organisation Act", "gist": "Legal act governing joint reporting procedure"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Red File (Roter Ordner)", "gist": "Document containing guidelines for the joint reporting procedure"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The Federal Chancellery is responsible for the joint reporting procedure", "gist": "Federal Chancellery must manage the joint reporting procedure"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Once the meeting is over, the section draws up the Federal Council decisions and issues them to the departments.", "gist": "After meetings, the section prepares and distributes Federal Council decisions to departments"}]}
